ModMetaData.name: BlueArchive-NewWorld Mac Fix
ModMetaData.author: Kevin-66
ModMetaData.description:
Unofficial macOS compatibility patch for BlueArchive-NewWorld.
- Replaces the mod's DirectX-only shaders (drawn magenta on Metal) with Mac-supported ones at runtime. - Stops "Animation not found" exceptions from Spine characters. - Removes an Anomaly-only stat when Anomaly is not active (red startup error).
Also run tools/apply_mac_fixes.py for the fixes that need file edits. See README.md.
